  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Japan
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Japan.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales
jobs.excerpt: Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
jobs.description:
Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.

These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.

Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.

Packback partners with 600+ higher education and K-12 institutions and is backed by growth equity firm PSG, with a platform proven to improve student writing confidence and cut instructor grading time by 30%.

About the role

We're looking for a VP of Sales to lead and scale Packback's sales organization as we grow our presence across higher education. This role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on leadership of the team responsible for new enterprise business — setting the overall direction for how Packback sells, structures, staffs, and compensates its sales function, while staying close enough to the field to coach Account Executives through institutional partnerships and faculty-driven adoption. You'll partner directly with the CEO and cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to set sales strategy, build the infrastructure to execute it, and expand our impact on campuses across the country. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

This is an opportunity for a senior sales leader who wants ownership over how a sales org is built, not just how it's run. You'll be accountable for revenue results, but you'll also shape org design, compensation strategy, and the long-term GTM architecture that determines how Packback scales.

Who is the ideal candidate?

  • You have experience leading enterprise sales organizations in EdTech, higher education, or another mission-driven B2B SaaS environment at the VP level or equivalent, and you've owned a sales org's structure and economics, not just its quota
  • You enjoy balancing strategy with execution — designing GTM motions and comp plans one day, joining a customer call or coaching a rep through a tough deal the next
  • You're comfortable operating as an executive partner to the CEO, translating market and pipeline data into strategy the leadership team and board can act on
  • You're motivated by building something meaningful and are excited by the opportunity to help colleges and universities improve student learning outcomes

What you'll do

  • Revenue Strategy & GTM Execution: Own the overarching sales strategy for the enterprise and B2C higher-ed business. Design and evolve go-to-market motions, organizational structure, staffing plans, and incentive structures in partnership with Finance and People to drive scalable growth.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives and front-line managers. Drive a high-performance culture through structured coaching on complex, multi-stakeholder deals—from discovery through close—and proactively recruit and onboard top sales talent. You’ll directly manage both front line managers as well as some enterprise sales representatives.
  • Sales Operations & Pipeline Management: Enforce forecast rigor and pipeline hygiene at the organizational level. Implement reliable processes, playbooks, and KPI tracking to ensure accurate forecasting and provide board-ready performance insights to the executive team.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Market Strategy: Drive deep alignment with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to optimize the end-to-end customer journey. Act as a market advocate, gathering insights from campus leaders and faculty to inform product direction and refine market narratives.

Requirements

  • 10+ years sales experience, including 3+ years leading multilayered teams (manager‑ and/or director‑level reports) in B2B SaaS or EdTech businesses
  • Demonstrated success selling complex solutions to higher education institutions or similarly complex organizations
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles while supporting higher-volume opportunities or multiple sales motions
  • Demonstrated success leading teams in account-based selling - navigate multi-stakeholder buying groups within each account, uncovering new sales opportunities and growing user adoption across the institution
  • Track record designing or redesigning quota, territory, or comp plans that improved attainment or efficiency
  • Strong coaching skills with a track record of improving individual and team performance
  • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance metrics
  • Expert negotiator - experience navigating and negotiating MSAs, data‑privacy addenda, and multi‑year pricing frameworks
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and executive-level customers
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Salesloft, or similar platforms
  • Experience with consultative sales methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDIC, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • A genuine interest in education and a desire to help institutions improve outcomes for students
  • Ability to travel up to 25-35 % for (domestic U.S.) for campus visits, conferences, and executive sponsor meetings

Additional Information:

Sponsorship: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without the need for sponsorship. Packback does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Location: Currently we are only able to hire from these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, MI, NJ, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI

About the team

The HR Compliance team is part of Zillow's Employee Service & Operations (ES&O) organization. ES&O focuses on delivering scalable, reliable services that support employees and managers across the company, bringing together operational expertise, systems, and shared services that enable Zillow's people processes to run smoothly.
Within ES&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.

About the role

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.

This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.

You Will:

  • Monitor new and emerging employment regulations across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions

  • Develop and maintain a compliance register and ownership mapping, ensuring risks and obligations are documented, assigned, and tracked

  • Develop and maintain compliance playbooks and operating standards that serve as the authoritative reference for operational teams executing programs

  • Support international employment compliance governance across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with regional HR and People Legal on country-specific regulatory obligations

  • Maintain audit-ready compliance controls and documentation across the program portfolio; coordinate internal and external audit activity, owning documentation standards, evidence organization, and audit response coordination in partnership with People Legal

  • Support preparation and submission of statutory government reports, including mandated federal and state workforce filings

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisory resource for stakeholder teams on compliance requirements

  • Establish and communicate the compliance guardrails that operational teams execute against, ensuring consistent application of standards across programs

  • Support development and implementation of actionable, accessible guidance

  • Contribute to compliance education efforts, helping stakeholders understand the intent and practical application of requirements

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $90,900.00 - $145,100.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You treat compliance as a discipline with standards, not a set of tasks to complete. You understand the regulatory intent behind requirements and can communicate it clearly to partners who don't work in this space

  • You are skilled at identifying risk before it becomes an issue, and you know how to document, escalate, and track it with rigor.

  • You draw a clear line between setting the standard and executing against it, and you hold that line in how you structure partnerships with operational teams.

  • You work confidently across jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks, and you know when a question requires legal escalation versus when you can resolve it directly.

  • You build credibility through accuracy, follow-through, and the quality of your documentation.

  • You are organized and deadline-driven, and you can manage multiple programs simultaneously without details falling through.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in HR compliance, employment law operations, or a related field with direct exposure to compliance program management

  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment laws and regulatory frameworks, including FLSA, EEO, FCRA, and related requirements

  • Experience with compliance risk identification, gap assessment, or audit coordination

  • Demonstrated ability to manage HR policy governance processes, including review cycles, version control, and legal alignment

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with a track record of managing multiple concurrent compliance programs

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting HR compliance programs in a multi-jurisdictional or global environment

jobs.description:
Commercial Project Delivery Director

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT

SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR POSITION

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Delivery Director. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Commercial Project Delivery Director owns the execution of SunStrong's construction and capital project portfolio and the quality of every asset handed to Operations. The role is accountable for schedule, cost, safety, and — distinctively — for the long-term operability of what gets built. It carries commercial ownership of EPC relationships, gate discipline across the delivery path, and the capability of the delivery team.
Part of this will be to create protocols, reporting and other organizational processes where none currently exist. This is not a scheduling or reporting role. The Director is expected to hold a gate against schedule pressure, to refuse an incomplete turnover package, and to defend a punchlist category on the record with a contractor who would prefer it to be dropped.

COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery Governance

  • Own the Project Delivery to Operations Protocol — maintain it, enforce it, and revise it against what each project cycle exposes.
  • Serve as decision authority at Gates 0, 2, and 6; support the VP of Commercial Operations at Gate 5 Operability Acceptance with a documented recommendation and risk position.
  • Resolve punchlist category disputes on the record; escalate to the VP any request to waive a Category A item.
  • Maintain the portfolio gate forecast and surface projected holds early enough that they are decisions rather than emergencies.
  • Establish and maintain the fleet equipment standard and the operability review checklist in partnership with Portfolio Management and Field Service.

FSP Commercial Ownership

  • Own the commercial relationship with Field Service Partners — selection, negotiation support, performance management, and escalation.
  • Direct contract abstraction and ensure Baseline Exposures are identified, owned, and mitigated before a project advances.
  • Negotiate change orders within delegated authority; prepare and defend positions above that threshold.
  • Maintain the FSP performance scorecard and translate it into award decisions, negotiated terms, and surveillance intensity on subsequent projects.
  • Pursue performance guarantee, warranty, workmanship, and latent defect claims in coordination with Legal and Asset Management before claim windows expire.

Portfolio Execution

  • Own aggregate schedule, cost, and cost-to-complete across the delivery portfolio; approve baseline changes.
  • Allocate Project Managers and Project Controls resources against project complexity, exposure, and geography.
  • Chair the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review.
  • Own the delivery risk register and drive mitigation to closure rather than to documentation.
  • Interface with Asset Management on COD-dependent lender, tax equity, and host obligations, and Finance on capital forecasting and cash flow.

Safety and Quality

  • Establish the owner-side safety expectation for EPC and subcontractor personnel; verify that stop-work authority is real on every site.
  • Ensure incident and near-miss investigation quality meets SSM standards regardless of which party performed the work.
  • Direct the Inspection and Test Plan review process and the designation of hold and witness points across the portfolio.
  • Drive quality trending — punchlist volume normalized to MW, recurrence rate, nonconformance disposition — into contractor selection and design standards.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build and develop the Project Delivery team — hiring, leveling, development plans, and succession.
  • Establish competency standards for advancement within the Project Manager ladder and the Project Controls track.
  • Drive the working relationship between Project Delivery and Operations so that operability input arrives at design review, not at turnover.
  • Represent Project Delivery to GoodFinch, lenders, tax equity partners, and host customers.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Ten or more years in construction or project delivery within energy, utility, or infrastructure, including five or more years leading project managers.
  • Demonstrated ownership of utility-scale or distributed generation construction portfolios, with direct EPC contract administration experience.
  • Working command of EPC agreement structure — substantial and final completion, performance guarantees, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, and change control.
  • Direct experience with commissioning, capacity and performance testing, and turnover acceptance.
  • Demonstrated ability to hold a commercial position with a contractor under schedule pressure.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV and battery energy storage delivery experience; familiarity with tracker, inverter, and BESS platform differences and their operational consequences.
  • Prior operations or asset management experience — the perspective this role is built to import into construction.
  • PMP, or PSP / CCP through AACE International.
  • Experience with acquired or in-flight construction portfolios and the transition of contractor relationships mid-project.
  • Interconnection, AHJ, and utility coordination experience across multiple jurisdictions.



Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Terminal.exe
jobs.excerpt: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.
jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide.

WEX is an innovative payments and technology company leading the way in a rapidly changing environment. We are moving away from fragmented legacy systems toward a modern API-first and Micro-Frontend (MFE) architecture.   • Orchestrate API and MFE Strategy: Partner with engineering to ensure our Micro-Frontend (MFE) strategy and backend APIs work in harmony to deliver a modular, "plug-and-play" experience for our users.

  • Systems-Thinking Mindset: Ability to balance micro-level user workflows with macro-level platform architecture.

Construction Project Coordinator (Commercial Construction) – Remote

Construction Administration | AIA Billing | Bonding | Buildertrend | Project Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Construction Project Coordinator to support the successful execution of commercial construction projects from pre-construction through project completion.

This is a detail-driven operations role responsible for managing construction contracts, bonding processes, AIA billing, project documentation, and administrative coordination across multiple active projects. You’ll work closely with project managers, contractors, municipalities, vendors, and clients to ensure projects remain organized, compliant, and on schedule.

If you thrive in structured environments, enjoy coordinating complex construction workflows, and have experience with commercial construction administration, this role offers the opportunity to become an integral part of a growing construction organization.

What You’ll Own

Contracts & Bonding Management

  • Review and manage commercial construction contracts throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate bid bonds, performance bonds, and maintenance bonds.
  • Prepare and submit bonding documentation accurately and on time.
  • Communicate with bonding companies, municipalities, and general contractors.
  • Track contract compliance and maintain organized project documentation.

AIA Billing & Project Administration

  • Prepare and submit AIA billing packages.
  • Maintain and update Schedule of Values (SOV).
  • Track retainage and project payment milestones.
  • Ensure billing submissions are accurate and completed on schedule.
  • Monitor deadlines and proactively identify potential payment or billing issues.

Buildertrend & Project Systems Management

  • Maintain project documentation within Buildertrend.
  • Track project schedules, milestones, receipts, and progress.
  • Keep project records accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Maintain CRM and project management system integrity.
  • Support leadership with project reporting and visibility.

Administrative & Project Support

  • Coordinate communication with clients, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
  • Support pre-construction and pre-sales administrative activities.
  • Organize contracts, permits, and project documentation.
  • Assist project managers with operational coordination.
  • Participate in weekly project meetings and provide project updates.

  • Experience working with commercial construction contracts.
  • Hands-on experience with AIA billing and payment applications.
  • Experience managing Schedule of Values (SOV).
  • Knowledge of bid bonds, performance bonds, and maintenance bonds.
  • Experience tracking retainage and construction billing documentation.

Core Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Outstanding organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple construction projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Buildertrend or similar construction management software.
  • Background in commercial construction, landscaping, or project management.
  • Experience with CRM and project tracking systems.
  • Basic bookkeeping or accounting experience within construction.
  • Familiarity with construction financial reporting and payment tracking.

Tools & Technologies

  • Buildertrend (Preferred)
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • CRM Systems
  • Construction Project Management Software

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized and exceptionally detail-oriented.
  • Thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset with excellent follow-through.
  • Comfortable coordinating multiple moving parts simultaneously.
  • Professional communicator with contractors, municipalities, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues before they become problems.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review commercial construction contracts and project documentation.
  • Prepare bonding packages and submit required documentation.
  • Process AIA billing applications and update Schedule of Values.
  • Track retainage, payment milestones, and billing schedules.
  • Update Buildertrend and project management systems.
  • Coordinate with contractors, municipalities, and vendors.
  • Participate in project meetings and communicate status updates.
  • Monitor project deadlines and ensure documentation remains accurate and complete.

In short: You serve as the operational backbone of commercial construction projects, ensuring contracts, billing, documentation, and project coordination remain accurate, compliant, and on schedule.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accurate and timely AIA billing submissions.
  • Successful management of bonding documentation and deadlines.
  • Accuracy of project records and CRM data.
  • Timely completion of contract administration tasks.
  • Reduced billing delays and payment issues.
  • Effective coordination across multiple active projects.
  • Consistent adherence to project deadlines and documentation requirements.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting commercial construction projects.
  • Opportunity to work closely with experienced project managers and leadership.
  • Strong ownership over project administration and coordination.

    • Project Manager

  4. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

jobs.description:
The Role

You'll own the backend, data, and infrastructure that deliver Forager's data to platform customers at scale — from ingestion all the way through to the APIs and feeds customers integrate against. This is a backend-first role: most of your time is spent building API features, operating our search and ETL data infrastructure, and owning the DevOps and platform layer underneath it. You'll also contribute to our customer-facing React/TypeScript web app, but that's the minority of the work.

This is a senior, high-ownership role on a small team. You won't just contribute features — you'll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You'll have direct input into product direction and the freedom (and responsibility) to ship work that materially moves our coverage, accuracy, latency, and uptime metrics.

What You'll Own

Ranked by where your time goes:

  • Backend & API development — real-time enrichment APIs (person/org lookup, contact data, reverse search), search and filter endpoints, waterfall enrichment logic, and the credit/billing surfaces customers meter against. Match rate, latency, and freshness directly drive customer value.
  • Data engineering, ETL & search infrastructure — own the Elasticsearch/ECK stack end-to-end (index and mapping design, ingestion pipelines, relevance tuning, cluster health, scaling, migrations), plus the ETL applications that move billions of data points daily into searchable stores, Snowflake data products, and warehouse exports while holding fill rates and accuracy.
  • DevOps & platform (core owner) — you own day-to-day AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and observability. This is not shared-on-the-side ops: you're responsible for infrastructure modernization, deployment pipelines, security scanning, log/metric consolidation, and the reliability of the systems you build.
  • Observability & data-quality tooling — build Grafana dashboards, load tests, and data-accuracy evals that make coverage, freshness, latency, and correctness measurable and continuously monitored across the data-quality surface.
  • Customer-facing web app (minority) — contribute to the React/TypeScript app, docs, onboarding, and self-serve surfaces when the work calls for it.

Core Responsibilities

Backend & API Development

  • Design, build, and operate RESTful APIs for enrichment, search, feeds, and platform-customer workflows.
  • Develop scalable backend services — workers, task queues, waterfall lookups, data pipelines — that keep refresh cycles predictable and fill rates high.
  • Build the metering, credit-logging, and billing logic that customers rely on for accurate consumption.
  • Participate actively in product planning; help shape which features have the highest customer impact.

Data Engineering, Search & ETL

  • Own the Elasticsearch / ECK search stack end-to-end: index design, ingestion, relevance, cluster health, scaling, and migrations.
  • Design and operate ETL applications moving data into searchable stores, bulk feeds, and warehouses (Snowflake, S3).
  • Optimize PostgreSQL — query performance, indexing, cache utilization.
  • Drive measurable improvements in latency, uptime, error rate, fill rate, and scalability.

DevOps & Infrastructure (Core Owner)

  • Own AWS infrastructure (ECS, S3, etc.) and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own observability — Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry — and on-call response for the surfaces you build.
  • Drive infrastructure modernization and share crawler infrastructure maintenance with the team.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Code review with high standards for readability, security, and performance.
  • Write unit, integration, and E2E tests — test reliability is a quality contributor, not overhead.
  • Document features, architecture, and API contracts; great developer docs are how our customers succeed.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems and APIs, with clear examples of strategic technical problem-solving (not just tenure).
  • Strong proficiency in Python / Django REST Framework.
  • Hands-on experience operating Elasticsearch / OpenSearch at scale — index/mapping design, query and relevance tuning, cluster management, migrations.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating ETL pipelines that move significant data volumes reliably.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and async task systems (Celery / RabbitMQ or equivalent).
  • Core-owner-level comfort with AWS (ECS, S3, CloudWatch), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent) — you're comfortable owning the platform, not just deploying to it.
  • Experience operating services in production — observability, on-call, incident response.
  • Working proficiency in React / TypeScript — comfortable shipping product UI when the work calls for it. (This is the minority of the role, not its center.)
  • Strong written communication; comfortable owning documentation as a deliverable.

AI & Agentic Workflows (Required)

This is non-negotiable. AI coding tools are core to how we build, and you're expected to operate effectively in an AI-augmented engineering environment. You must demonstrate strong, hands-on fluency with:

  • AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) used daily for implementation, refactoring, and code review — while validating all generated output before it reaches production.
  • Agentic workflows — designing, orchestrating, and debugging multi-step agent pipelines (e.g., research → plan → implement → verify loops, MCP server integration, tool-use design).
  • Judgment about where AI helps vs. hurts — knowing when to delegate to an agent, when to write the code yourself, and how to keep an agent on rails for production work.

We evaluate this in interviews with live exercises. Candidates without demonstrable agentic workflow experience will not be considered.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or other data warehouses.
  • Background in B2B data products — enrichment, contact data, company data, search/discovery.
  • Experience with data-privacy/compliance engineering — GDPR/PII handling, US state privacy regimes.
  • Building MCP servers.
  • Experience with web crawling, data sourcing, or large-scale ingestion systems.
  • Open-source contributions or public technical writing.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay for your location — calibrated to your experience and where you're based.
  • Flexible working hours — we care about output and overlap, not clock-watching.
  • Untracked PTO — take the time off you need; there's no accrual to count.
  • Relaxed working environment — small team, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. Anyone can take an idea to production without jumping through hoops.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a WordPress Developer to build, customize, optimize, and maintain high-performing WordPress websites that support business growth and digital marketing initiatives.

This role combines strong WordPress development expertise with a solid understanding of website performance, SEO, responsive design, and user experience. You’ll work closely with marketing, content, and design teams to develop visually polished, conversion-focused websites that are fast, secure, and easy to maintain.

From custom page builds and plugin integrations to performance optimization and troubleshooting, you’ll own the complete website development lifecycle while ensuring every site delivers an exceptional user experience.

If you’re passionate about WordPress development and enjoy building websites that are both technically sound and marketing-driven, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

WordPress Development & Customization

  • Build and customize WordPress websites using Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Gutenberg, or custom development.
  • Develop and maintain custom WordPress themes and child themes.
  • Create responsive landing pages, blogs, templates, and marketing-focused web pages.
  • Customize layouts and functionality using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Convert Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch designs into responsive WordPress pages.

Plugin Management & Integrations

  • Install, configure, and customize WordPress plugins including:
    • WooCommerce
    • Yoast SEO
    • Contact Form 7
    • Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
  • Troubleshoot plugin conflicts and compatibility issues.
  • Extend website functionality through custom PHP development.
  • Integrate CRMs, analytics tools, marketing platforms, and third-party APIs.

Website Performance & SEO Optimization

  • Optimize website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance.
  • Implement:
    • Caching
    • Image optimization
    • Lazy loading
    • CDN integration
    • Code minification
  • Perform website audits using Google Lighthouse, GTmetrix, and PageSpeed Insights.
  • Apply technical SEO best practices, including metadata, schema markup, heading structure, and mobile optimization.

Website Maintenance & Security

  • Manage WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates.
  • Monitor website uptime, backups, and overall website health.
  • Implement security best practices using tools such as Wordfence, Sucuri, or iThemes Security.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, hosting issues, broken layouts, and website errors.
  • Maintain secure, stable, and reliable website environments.

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with marketing and design teams to launch campaigns and website updates.
  • Support non-technical team members with CMS updates and content management.
  • Maintain organized staging environments and deployment workflows.
  • Document website changes, configurations, and technical processes.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have strong hands-on WordPress development experience.
  • You care about clean code, responsive layouts, and website performance.
  • You balance technical implementation with marketing and user experience goals.
  • You proactively solve problems and take ownership of website quality.
  • You communicate effectively while working independently in remote teams.
  • You consistently deliver polished, reliable websites.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional WordPress development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • WordPress
    • PHP
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Experience with page builders such as:
    • Elementor
    • Divi
    • WPBakery
    • Gutenberg
  • Experience managing hosting environments including:
    • WP Engine
    • SiteGround
    • Kinsta
    • cPanel
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Responsive design
    • Cross-browser compatibility
    • Website speed optimization
    • Technical SEO
  • Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • WooCommerce development and e-commerce websites.
  • Experience building or extending custom WordPress plugins.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and staging/deployment environments.
  • Experience integrating APIs, CRMs, or marketing automation platforms.
  • Background working with agencies, SaaS companies, or high-growth businesses.

What Success Looks Like

  • Website projects and updates are delivered on time.
  • Websites consistently load in under three seconds.
  • Strong Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance scores.
  • Minimal downtime and security incidents.
  • Responsive, visually polished, and conversion-focused websites.
  • Positive feedback from marketing, design, and leadership teams.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (Landing Page Build or Website Optimization Task)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a WordPress Developer who enjoys building fast, secure, and high-performing websites, thrives on solving technical challenges, and wants to create digital experiences that drive business growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build websites that are optimized for performance, usability, and long-term success.

The RSM is accountable for territory revenue driven by these motions, direct sales where appropriate and productive resource utilization. Success is defined less by what the RSM personally closes and more by how well the RSM directs, enables, and holds accountable the sellers, branches, and partners operating in the territory. The position requires channel management discipline, branch-level relationship ownership, Partner Program execution, and the judgment to know when to sell directly versus when to scale through the Reps.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Lead the Rep Firm Channel in Territory: Manage, enable, and hold accountable the Rep Firm Reps operating in the territory. Build joint territory plans with the Reps, run a weekly cadence, drive partner adoption, and use sell-through data to manage their performance. The RSM is the leader of the sellers in the territory and executes the Rep Firm strategy set at the corporate level.
  • Own and Drive National Dealer Branches: Serve as the named RSM contact for every National Dealer branch and local sales team in territory. Support and drive sales inside these large enterprise security dealers and integrators, execute every corporate-led play at the branch level, and surface field intelligence back to Strategic Accounts leadership.
  • Grow the Partner Program Through Distribution: Recruit, enroll, certify, and develop indirect security dealers who buy through distribution. Drive Partner Program enrollment and tier progression and use distributor sell-through data to find buyers worth growing.
  • Own Regional Distributor and Direct OEM Accounts (Direct): Act as the primary, direct account owner for every Regional Distributor in territory (single-territory distributors under $25M in annual revenue), including relationship, planning, and revenue growth.
  • Revenue Accountability: Own and deliver the territory revenue quota across all four motions. Influence product mix, solution expansion, and Inovonics Intrusion System (IIS) adoption throughout the territory.
  • IIS (Inovonics Intrusion System) Adoption: Drive introduction and adoption of the Inovonics Intrusion System (IIS) across the Reps, National Dealer branches, and Partner Program dealers in territory. Facilitate warm handoffs to the IIS Sales Specialist, support onboarding and activation, and achieve IIS adoption targets.
  • Salesforce Discipline: Log every customer interaction in Salesforce with the required Task Type, keep account plans current on every key account, and maintain accurate channel, branch, and certification data.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in territory, channel, or account management, preferably in security, technology, or B2B sales
  • Demonstrated success managing through indirect sellers (rep firms, manufacturer reps, or distribution) and driving revenue through a channel
  • Experience owning branch-level or enterprise account relationships
  • Ability to understand and represent technical products to business audiences
  • Strong verbal and written communication; ability to speak effectively to audiences ranging from technical staff to executives
  • Excellent organization and time management; ability to lead multiple sellers and partners at once
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), Microsoft Office, and enterprise Gen-AI tools
  • Ability to travel approximately 2 trips per month

Employees must maintain a valid license and acceptable driving record for the duration of their employment and must immediately report any changes in license status (suspension, revocation, restriction, or expiration) to their manager or HR.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience managing rep firms, manufacturer reps, or distributor relationships

CORE COMPETENCIES

Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you!

The Regulatory Compliance Specialist coordinates and manages the timely, accurate, and secure response to external regulatory audits, investigations, and requests for information involving the organization's Mobility and Personal Care Services businesses.

The role serves as a project lead for requests from entities such as Medicaid Fraud Control Units (MFCUs), Unified Program Integrity Contractors (UPICs), the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ), Office of Inspector General (OIG), Attorneys General, state Medicaid agencies, and Medicaid managed care organizations (MCOs). The Specialist coordinates with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Claims, Clinical/Personal Care, Finance, Provider Management, IT, and other stakeholders to identify, retrieve, validate, organize, and prepare responsive information, including claims data, trip/service records, billing and payment data, provider records, contracts, rate information, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation. This position requires strong project management, audit, data analysis, written communication, and judgment skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority matters and regulatory deadlines simultaneously.

This role...

  • Serve as the primary coordinator and project lead for external audit, regulatory, investigative, and information requests from MFCUs, UPICs, DOJ, OIG, Attorneys General, state Medicaid programs, MCO clients, and other authorized oversight entities.

  • Intake and assess each request to understand its scope, applicable business area, population, date range, requested records, response format, due dates, and required stakeholders; establish a documented workplan and response timeline.

  • Manage multiple concurrent requests from initiation through final submission, maintaining an audit/request tracker, status reporting, action items, dependencies, deliverables, and deadlines to ensure timely completion.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to obtain responsive records and data from Mobility and Personal Care Services operations, including trip logs, service records, claims and encounter data, billing/payment information, provider records, contracts, rate sheets, policies, procedures, and related documentation.

  • Perform detailed reviews of retrieved records and datasets for completeness, accuracy, consistency, relevancy, and responsiveness to the request; identify gaps, discrepancies, duplicates, or exceptions and coordinate resolution with the appropriate business owners.

  • Prepare and organize response packages, including data files, supporting records, exhibits, document indexes, summaries, chronologies, and draft written responses, consistent with request requirements and internal review standards.

  • Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on matters requiring legal interpretation, privilege considerations, regulatory strategy, escalation, or review of proposed responses; promptly escalate potential compliance, fraud, abuse, or material operational issues identified during the response process.

  • Communicate professionally with internal stakeholders and, when authorized, external requestors to clarify information needs, resolve questions, confirm response requirements, and manage submission logistics and deadlines.

  • Maintain a secure, organized repository of request-related materials, correspondence, workpapers, source data, final response packages, and submission records in accordance with records retention, privacy, security, and document control requirements.

  • Use Microsoft Excel and other reporting or data tools to analyze large datasets, identify trends or anomalies, reconcile information across systems, and develop clear supporting schedules for regulatory and audit responses.

  • Support follow-up requests, supplemental documentation, interviews, and additional questions that arise after an initial submission, maintaining version control and a complete record of communications and deliverables.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the organization's processes for responding to government investigations, regulatory audits, client audits, and information requests, including standardization, tracking, reporting, documentation, and turnaround time.

  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable healthcare, Medicaid, privacy, records management, audit, and regulatory requirements relevant to the organization's Mobility and Personal Care Services businesses.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

We are excited to speak to someone with...

  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, health information management, compliance, accounting, criminal justice, public administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

  • Three (3) plus years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare audit, regulatory response, compliance, investigations, project management, healthcare operations, or a related field required.

  • Direct experience responding to government or regulatory requests from entities such as MFCU, UPIC, DOJ, OIG, Attorneys General, state Medicaid agencies, or MCOs strongly preferred.

  • Experience managing audits or information requests involving claims data, trip/service records, billing or payment data, provider records, or other healthcare documentation strongly preferred.

  • Experience in Medicaid, NEMT/mobility, personal care services, home care, managed care, or another regulated healthcare environment preferred.

  • Experience using Excel for data analysis, reconciliation, filtering, pivot tables, lookups, and preparation of supporting schedules preferred.

  • Project management, audit, compliance, healthcare data, or fraud/waste/abuse training or certification is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience managing external audits, regulatory inquiries, investigations, information requests, or similar compliance-driven projects in a healthcare or other highly regulated environment.

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to establish workplans, manage competing priorities, track dependencies, drive action items, and meet firm regulatory or contractual deadlines.

  • Working knowledge of Medicaid programs, healthcare claims, healthcare operations, fraud, waste and abuse concepts, and regulatory oversight processes; experience with NEMT, mobility, personal care, home care, or related services strongly preferred.

  • Ability to interpret detailed requests, break complex requirements into actionable tasks, and determine the records, data, and subject matter expertise needed to support a complete response.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to review, reconcile, and validate claims, service, trip, billing, payment, provider, and other operational data across multiple systems and sources.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications; experience working with large datasets, reporting tools, or data visualization platforms preferred.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to draft clear, concise, fact-based summaries and responses for internal and external audiences.

  • Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential, regulated, and potentially investigative information.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise appropriate escalation judgment, and collaborate effectively with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Claims, Finance, IT, Provider Management, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to maintain organized workpapers, version control, document indexes, supporting schedules, and audit trails sufficient to demonstrate how a response was developed and supported.

  • Professional communication skills and the ability to manage high-priority requests in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements and tight deadlines.

jobs.excerpt: The Data Platform Administration Architect is responsible for the architecture, administration, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data platform.
jobs.description:
The Data Platform Administration Architect is responsible for the architecture, administration, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data platform. This role owns the stability, scalability, security, availability, and supportability of cloud-based data platforms, with a primary focus on Databricks, Azure Data Services, and enterprise platform operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong operational leadership and has extensive experience managing production environments, release processes, change governance, incident response, service management, and platform modernization initiatives. This individual will serve as the technical lead for platform administration while partnering with engineering, infrastructure, security, governance, and business teams to ensure reliable and compliant data platform operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the administration, architecture, governance, and operational support of enterprise data platforms.
  • Manage and support Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, and related Azure services across production and non-production environments.
  • Own platform reliability, availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Define and maintain platform standards, environment strategies, monitoring frameworks, operational procedures, and governance controls.
  • Oversee Change Management and Release Management processes, including CRs, SCRs, ECRs, deployment planning, release scheduling, rollback strategies, and post-release validation.
  • Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) activities and provide technical assessment, risk evaluation, and deployment readiness recommendations.
  • Lead production support activities, including resolution of Incidents (INC), Service Requests (RITM), Problem Records, and Major Incident Management processes.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical production incidents and ensure timely restoration of services.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and drive preventative and corrective actions to reduce recurring issues.
  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, knowledge articles, support documentation, escalation procedures, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Establish and report on operational KPIs including platform uptime, SLA compliance, release success rates, Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), incident trends, and platform health metrics.
  • Implement and govern CI/CD processes, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards, access governance policies, audit requirements, and SOX controls.
  • Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation opportunities, cost optimization, and continuous service improvement efforts.
  • Mentor platform engineers and administrators while providing technical leadership and architectural direction.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data platforms, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform administration, or data operations.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks and Azure data platforms in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong expertise with:
    • Databricks
    • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
    • Azure Synapse Analytics
    • Azure SQL
    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
    • Azure DevOps
    • Azure IAM (RBAC, Service Principals, Managed Identities)
    • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
  • Proven experience as a Data Platform Administrator, Databricks Administrator, Azure Platform Administrator, Platform Architect, or Platform Operations Lead, not solely a data engineer or application developer.
  • Deep understanding of standing up, configuring, securing, governing, and supporting production and non-production Databricks environments.
  • Experience managing platform provisioning, environment strategy, capacity planning, workload management, performance tuning, cost optimization, and operational support.
  • Strong experience implementing and managing platform monitoring, observability, alerting, and operational dashboards.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise production support processes, including:
    • Incidents (INC)
    • Service Requests (RITM)
    • Change Requests (CR)
    • Standard Changes (SCR)
    • Emergency Changes (ECR)
    • Problem Management
  • Hands-on experience coordinating and leading enterprise release management activities, including release planning, deployment execution, rollback planning, deployment validation, and post-release support.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL-aligned operational processes, including:
    • Incident Management
    • Change Management
    • Release Management
    • Problem Management
    • Service Request Management
    • Knowledge Management
    • Major Incident Management
  • Experience resolving and leading response efforts for critical production incidents (P1/P2/P3), including executive communications and stakeholder coordination.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and presenting comprehensive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and corrective action plans following production incidents.
  • Experience establishing support operating models, on-call rotations, escalation procedures, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Strong experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms for managing incidents, changes, requests, approvals, releases, and audit requirements.
  • Experience developing operational metrics, service-level reporting, trend analysis, and platform health dashboards.
  • Experience designing scalable platform controls and operational processes to support enterprise data volumes and growth.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD automation, deployment pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Azure DevOps best practices.
  • Experience with cloud governance, platform security, access management, and compliance controls.
  • Experience supporting SOX-compliant, regulated, or audit-driven environments.
  • Ability to partner effectively with infrastructure, security, networking, application, and business teams to drive platform reliability and operational excellence.
  • Proven leadership experience managing platform, operations, or engineering teams.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAll of us, for each of you, every time.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

All of us, for each of you, every time.

Our Vision

Together, serving as the trusted regional healthcare partner.

Our Values

Listen~Love~Respect~Excel~Innovate

At Samaritan, we do more than deliver healthcare—we make a meaningful difference in the lives of our community every day. We’re committed to creating an exceptional workplace where professionals feel valued, supported, and inspired to provide outstanding care to every patient we serve.

The Certified Medical Coder will be responsible for reviewing all medical record information to extract data and apply appropriate diagnoses and procedure codes for billing, internal and external reporting, research, and regulatory compliance. Accurately codes conditions and procedures as documented in the Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting. Acts as a coding resource for team members as well as medical staff, ensuring coding practices fall with the established compliance guidelines for ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT & HCPCS according to American Medical Association (AMA) and CMS. Assigning codes utilizing an electronic encoder application in accordance with the practice policy and regulatory guidelines. This is a full-time remote position that will be required to come onsite for onboarding and equipment pick-up (2 DAYS ONLY). This position is a full-time role working Monday-Friday from 7:00am-3:30pm.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Ability to extract and assign ICD-10CM/PCS, CPT, Modifiers and HCPCS codes per coding guidelines.
  2. Performs ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT coding and abstracting, and transmit abstracts as required.
  3. Codes all records based on documentation, following coding guidelines, payer regulations and ethics.
  4. Ability to research Coding Clinics.
  5. Assists with coding audits from payor and RAC audits providing rebuttal letters if needed.
  6. Apply knowledge of coding rules, review and resolve CCI/LCD/NCD’s and modifier edits.
  7. Work with Revenue Integrity & Compliance on audits and coding questions.
  8. Effectively uses software and/or coding resources to verify coding accuracy.
  9. Provides feedback to providers using authorized methods as directed by department policy. Such as physician queries for incomplete/contradictory diagnosis or greater specificity.
  10. Works with clinical staff to resolve coding issues and related problems.
  11. Participates in educational activities as requested (i.e. attending meetings with coding auditors or completing assigned education).
  12. Reviews accounts and charges in EPIC, Cerner, or Meditech EHR systems.
  13. Maintains confidentiality of the medical record, reports and Samaritan business
  14. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in field of expertise.
  15. Perform general office and clerical duties (i.e. answer phones, distribute mail and maintain general office supplies). Operates office equipment.
  16. Ensures no injuries to self or others by following safe work practices and policies. This includes, but is not limited to: security and safety, understanding of MSDS, equipment, infection control, fire, disaster, safe lifting and body mechanics.
  17. Ensures self-compliance with organization policies and procedures as well as labor agreements.
  18. Ensures the interface with team members and other support groups is conducted in a courteous and efficient manner conducive with the organization’s values.
  19. Conducts self in a professional manner and ensures personal appearance meets the standards necessary to perform the job function while representing the organization.
  20. Ensures that additional accountabilities, as may be required by management, be handled in a manner necessary to meet organizational standards.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The professional in this position reports to the Manager of Health Information Management. This position works closely with clinical professionals and other healthcare professionals in order to provide high quality services to all customers.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Education:
    1. High school diploma or equivalent required.
    2. Associates degree preferred.
  • Certification:
    1. RHIT, CCS, RHIA, CPC, CPC-H, CPC-A or CCA.
  • Experience:
    1. Minimum of 1 year experience coding.
  • Skills/Competencies:
    1. Knowledge of ICD-10, CPT coding, medical terminology, and insurance billing.
    2. Understanding of DRG’s for Inpatient Facility coding positions desired.
    3. Training and/ or experience in Medical Terminology
    4. Anatomy and Physiology classes
    5. Experience with EPIC EHR desired.
    6. Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
    7. Excellent customer service skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  1. Occasional standing, walking, lifting, reaching, kneeling, bending, stooping, pushing and pulling. Light physical effort, ability to lift up to 10 lbs.
  2. Ability to communicate using verbal and/or written skills for accurate exchange of information with physicians, nurses, health care professionals, patients and/or family, and the public.

As a Samaritan professional, you will be asked to carry out the Mission, Vision, Values, and Strategy of Samaritan, personifying service and operational excellence including the creation and maintenance of the best patient, professional, physician, and student experience.

Founded in 2005, Pierce Washington helps clients transform their quote-to-cash process. We are creating a next-generation Total Commerce Company and will own the Total Commerce category – a fast growing segment in the tech industry. This is the place to come to if you want to work with the best, get in at the ground floor and help sustain and grow one of the best places to work. We have completed over 100 CPQ projects enabling leading enterprise companies to achieve their most complex Q2C process automation goals and transform how they do business.

Leveraging this expertise, our Salesforce Practice is focused on delivering Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions to clients in the High Tech and Manufacturing industries. Come join a growing Salesforce Practice and work on fun projects with good people!

Who are you?

You are an experienced functional Solution Architect who specializes in the Salesforce Revenue Cloud and loves to work collaboratively with clients to design and implement CPQ (Steelbrick) solutions. You strive for and deliver excellence for yourself, your team, and your clients. You have a natural curiosity to uncover a client’s pain points, key requirements and implicit needs and the charisma to cast a vision for what is possible with the Revenue Cloud.

You architect solutions and then guide the Consultants and Developers on your project team to implement your solution designs by leveraging your declarative configuration expertise working with products and price books, price rules, flows, advanced approvals, discounting, quoting, invoicing, and amendment and renewal processes and your experience working with Developers to build custom Salesforce applications and integrate Salesforce with ERP and other systems. This will be a 100% remote position.

What you get to do:
